text_simplified: The blessing of parents' righteousness extends to preserving their children for years after their death, and a parent earns the reward of instilling Islam in his child according to the statement of the Prophet ﷺ: "Whoever establishes a good practice in Islam will have its reward and the reward of whoever acts upon it after him, without anything being diminished from their rewards" (Sahih Muslim 1017). A mother should reduce frequent outings to markets and social events to dedicate herself to caring for her home and daughters, and both parents should read and consult to learn the best methods of Islamic upbringing.

review_defects.why: «سبل التربية» means "the ways/methods of upbringing"; the English adds "Sound" and drops the sense of learning the methods.
«المربي» (the educator/upbringer) is broader than "a parent", and «نفس طفله» (his child's soul) drops "soul".
